arc_wickmoor.title: Wickmoor
arc_wickmoor.summary: A village on the edge of Accord country, a stranger asking the wrong questions politely, and one morning that ends all of it.
themes: what was kept, and who agreed to keep it

seeds.text: Bryn Wick was taken alive, by people who had the wrong child.
Somebody in Harrowmoot took the other half of the keeping.
Cotter Vane did something in the last year of the war that he has never named.

arc_harrowmoot.title: Assay Row
arc_harrowmoot.summary: A tithe-town where the oil is cheap because two powers are fighting over it, and the woman you were sent to find has spent eleven years making certain nobody does.
themes: what hiding costs the person doing it

seeds.text: The Row's assay ledger lists every unlicensed caster reported in forty miles.
Nine Shepherds died getting one child out. Bel will not say which child.
Emeric Sallow's pension was four marks a month, and somebody is still collecting it.

cmp_cinderhold.title: Cinderhold
cmp_cinderhold.premise: The Meridian Syndicate did not fight the war — it supplied both sides, and when the empires bled out the supplier was the only thing left standing. It governs by owning what everyone needs. Somewhere under all of that is the reason a village burned.
